text: H00 complete: hetero2d.js heterogeneous rectangle engine built and verified. Per-piece geometry, heterogeneous rect-rect SAT, per-piece disk->rectangle morph, square container. Smoke test: 5 rectangles, harden L=3.0613, rigid L=3.0441, independent verifier confirms zero overlap (worst penetration 1e-12). Parent engine untouched. Ready for H01 fidelity-transfer campaigns.

H01: fidelity rule DOES NOT TRANSFER to heterogeneous rectangles per preregistered rule (rho=-0.387 passes magnitude bar <-0.3, but one-sided p=0.135 fails p<0.05; n=10). Harden wins only 2/10 (vs 20/67 on congruent). Instances look 'easy': 6/10 have harden gap=0.0000 (both methods find optima). Directionally consistent (negative rho) but underpowered. Two readings: (a) the rule genuinely doesn't transfer to heterogeneous; (b) the test lacked hard instances with variation. Next: harder instances (larger n, wider size variance) or more instances before concluding.

decision: does not transfer per rule; underpowered

text: H02: fidelity rule TRANSFERS to heterogeneous rectangles on hard instances — decisively (rho=-0.816, one-sided p<0.0001; bar was rho<-0.3, p<0.05; n=18). Harden wins 6/18 (vs 2/10 in H01). Pattern is clean: high fidelity (>0.9) -> harden wins or ties with zero gap (bimodal instances b1-b3, e1-e2, a4); low fidelity (<0.2) -> harden loses with large gaps (wide-uniform, aspect-mix). The H01 null was a power/easiness artifact, not a genuine non-transfer. The rule holds for heterogeneous packing when instances discriminate.

H03: 3D hardening dominates (4 wins, 4 ties, 0 losses vs rigid on cubes-in-cube n=9-18) BUT the fidelity mechanism does NOT cleanly replicate. Preregistered bar technically met (rho=-0.764, p=0.014) yet degenerate: gaps all ~0 (harden hits optimum everywhere, no outcome variation) and fidelities uniformly low (max 0.21) even on wins — opposite the 2D pattern. The correlation is a numerical artifact. Honest reading: hardening works in 3D, but via a mechanism the current fidelity measure doesn't capture (sphere->cube is a bigger topological jump; the morph may do more work). Umbrella paper stays 2D-only; 3D is future work with its own puzzle.

decision: harden wins 4/8; fidelity mechanism not confirmed in 3D
